description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Grazing Kelpie.
When Grazing Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grazing Kelpie.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
